points.S1: 内外压差：玻璃会内爆或爆裂
points.K1: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
points.S2: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵
points.K2: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
points.S3: 密闭体系不加热，留泄压通道

points.K4: 产气的反应和培养防憋压

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在真空泵和防护屏旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a small vacuum pump and a clear safety shield on a lab bench, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：真空与压力操作。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指着抽真空的烧瓶和高压釜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a round bottom flask connected to a vacuum line and a small steel pressure reactor.
shots.narration: 压差看不见，玻璃却扛不住。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一个薄壁平底锥形瓶准备抽真空
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a thin walled flat bottomed conical flask and reaches for a vacuum hose.
shots.narration: 阿杰随手拿了个平底瓶要抽真空。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 瓶底有一道星状细裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Close-up diagram: a small star shaped crack on the bottom of a glass flask, a magnifier over it. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶底还有一道细裂纹。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着防护屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at the cracked flask and a safety shield.
shots.narration: 小研：这样抽，瓶子会内爆！

shots.section_title: 内外压差：玻璃会内爆或爆裂
shots.scene: 大气压从四面压向抽空的烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: many arrows pressing inward on an evacuated round flask from all sides, empty space inside. No text.
shots.narration: 抽真空时，大气从外面压瓶子。
overlay: 内外压差：玻璃会内爆或爆裂

shots.section_title: 内外压差：玻璃会内爆或爆裂
shots.scene: 烧瓶向内塌缩，碎片四溅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass flask collapsing inward and then glass fragments flying outward in all directions, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶子一破，碎片反而向外飞溅。

shots.section_title: 内外压差：玻璃会内爆或爆裂
shots.scene: 加压容器内部压力向外推
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: arrows pushing outward from inside a sealed glass vessel, the vessel bursting. No text.
shots.narration: 加压时正好相反，从里往外崩。

shots.section_title: 内外压差：玻璃会内爆或爆裂
shots.scene: 玻璃碎片和溶剂一起喷出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: glass fragments flying together with a splash of solvent toward a face outline, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃夹着溶剂，伤眼伤脸。

shots.section_title: 内外压差：玻璃会内爆或爆裂
shots.scene: 裂纹、划痕、薄壁、平底几个弱点图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons of weak glassware, a crack, a scratch, a thin wall and a flat bottom, each with a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 裂纹和薄弱处，最先破。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 【实拍】对着光转动圆底烧瓶检查裂纹（空瓶）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands slowly rotating an empty round bottom flask against a light to look for cracks.
shots.narration: 减压前，先对着光查裂纹。
overlay: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 星状裂纹、划痕、缺口的烧瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three flasks with a star crack, a deep scratch and a chipped neck, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 有裂纹、划痕、缺口的，不用。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 圆底烧瓶和厚壁抽滤瓶打勾，薄壁平底瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round bottom flask and a thick walled filter flask with ticks, a thin flat bottomed conical flask and a beaker crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只用圆底瓶等耐真空器皿。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 干燥器、杜瓦瓶也是真空器皿
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass vacuum desiccator and a glass dewar flask with arrows showing vacuum inside. No text.
shots.narration: 真空干燥器、杜瓦瓶也会内爆。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 【实拍】给真空干燥器外缠透明胶带或套防护网（不抽真空）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands wrapping clear tape around a glass vacuum desiccator, then fitting a plastic mesh cage over it.
shots.narration: 大的玻璃真空容器缠胶带或套网。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 抽真空的装置前立起防护屏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum glass apparatus in a fume hood with a clear safety shield standing in front of it. No text.
shots.narration: 必要时加防护屏，或放通风柜里。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 通风柜视窗拉低挡在面前
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume hood sash pulled down in front of a vacuum apparatus, a person standing behind it. No text.
shots.narration: 视窗拉低，挡住可能的碎片。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 戴护目镜，必要时加面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing safety goggles and a face shield adjusts a vacuum apparatus behind a shield.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜，必要时再加面屏。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 慢慢打开真空阀，不猛抽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand slowly turning a vacuum valve with a gentle curved arrow, a fast jerk crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 抽气、放气都要慢，别猛开猛关。

shots.section_title: 减压前查裂纹，用耐压器皿加防护
shots.scene: 抽真空的瓶子不磕碰、不局部加热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an evacuated flask being knocked by a tool and heated by a flame at one spot, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 抽着真空，别磕碰别局部猛烧。

shots.section_title: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵
shots.scene: 泵和体系之间串一个安全瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum pump, a safety trap bottle in the middle and the apparatus, connected in a line with arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 泵和体系之间，接上安全瓶。
overlay: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵

shots.section_title: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵
shots.scene: 【实拍】厚壁真空管连接安全瓶，检查管子无老化（不开泵）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands connecting thick walled vacuum tubing to a safety trap bottle and bending the tubing to check for cracks.
shots.narration: 用厚壁真空管，老化开裂就换。

shots.section_title: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵
shots.scene: 先通大气放气，再关泵
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two steps with arrows, first a hand opening the vent valve to let air in, then a hand switching off the pump. No text.
shots.narration: 结束时先放气，再关泵。

shots.section_title: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵
shots.scene: 先关泵导致液体倒吸进体系，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water or pump oil flowing backward from the pump into the apparatus after the pump is stopped first, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 顺序反了，水或泵油会倒吸。

shots.section_title: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵
shots.scene: 【实拍】查看油泵油位窗（泵不运行）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger pointing at the oil level window on the side of a stopped rotary vacuum pump.
shots.narration: 用前看泵油油位和颜色。

shots.section_title: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵
shots.scene: 泵油发黑浑浊，按规程换油
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dark cloudy pump oil next to clean oil, a maintenance wrench and a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 油脏了按规程更换，记录在案。

shots.section_title: 真空泵操作：安全瓶防倒吸，先放气后停泵
shots.scene: 泵放在通风稳固处，皮带有护罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum pump on a stable low shelf with space around it and a guard covering its drive belt. No text.
shots.narration: 泵放稳通风，皮带要有护罩。

shots.section_title: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
shots.scene: 泵的排气口冒出溶剂蒸气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: solvent vapour coming out of the exhaust port of a vacuum pump into the room, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 抽出来的溶剂，会从泵口排出。
overlay: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂

shots.section_title: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
shots.scene: 排气管接进通风柜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hose running from the pump exhaust port into a fume hood, airflow arrows going up the duct. No text.
shots.narration: 泵的尾气，用管子引进通风柜。

shots.section_title: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
shots.scene: 体系和泵之间装冷阱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cold trap placed between the apparatus and the vacuum pump, vapour turning into droplets inside the trap. No text.
shots.narration: 泵前装冷阱，把溶剂冻住挡下。

shots.section_title: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
shots.scene: 冷阱保护泵也保护人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean pump with a tick and a person breathing clean air, both protected by the cold trap. No text.
shots.narration: 保护泵油，也少让人吸蒸气。

shots.section_title: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
shots.scene: 【实拍】冷阱杜瓦的摆放和固定（空杜瓦，不加冷剂）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands placing an empty dewar around a glass cold trap and fixing it on a stable stand.
shots.narration: 冷阱杜瓦放稳，戴防冻手套操作。

shots.section_title: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
shots.scene: 液氮冷阱先抽真空再放冷剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two steps, first the system is evacuated, then the cold dewar is raised around the trap, a snowflake icon. No text.
shots.narration: 液氮冷阱先抽真空，再套冷剂。

shots.section_title: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
shots.scene: 冷阱里的溶剂和接收瓶溶剂倒进废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid from a cold trap and a receiving flask poured into a labelled waste solvent container. No text.
shots.narration: 冷阱和接收瓶的溶剂，按废液收集。

shots.section_title: 真空泵尾气进通风柜，冷阱挡溶剂
shots.scene: 废泵油装桶按危险废物交
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used pump oil drained into a closed container placed at a hazardous waste collection point. No text.
shots.narration: 换下的废泵油，按危险废物交。

shots.section_title: 密闭体系不加热，留泄压通道
shots.scene: 密闭的烧瓶在加热板上，压力上升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fully closed flask on a hot plate with a rising pressure arrow inside, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 密闭体系一加热，压力就往上冲。
overlay: 密闭体系不加热，留泄压通道

shots.section_title: 密闭体系不加热，留泄压通道
shots.scene: 密闭加热的瓶子炸开，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed flask bursting on a hot plate, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 普通玻璃装置，绝不密闭加热。

shots.section_title: 密闭体系不加热，留泄压通道
shots.scene: 回流装置顶端通大气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reflux setup with a condenser whose top is open to the air through a drying tube, an airflow arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 回流、加热，要有通大气的出口。

shots.section_title: 密闭体系不加热，留泄压通道
shots.scene: 惰性气体保护接鼓泡器泄压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inert gas line connected to a flask with an oil bubbler outlet releasing small bubbles. No text.
shots.narration: 通惰性气体，也要接鼓泡器泄压。

shots.section_title: 密闭体系不加热，留泄压通道
shots.scene: 出口被堵、阀门全关，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blocked outlet tube and all valves closed on a heated apparatus, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 出口别堵死，阀门别全关。

shots.section_title: 密闭体系不加热，留泄压通道
shots.scene: 加压设备的安全阀和爆破片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure vessel with a safety valve and a rupture disc marked by arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 加压设备靠安全阀、爆破片泄压。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 带压反应只在合格高压釜里做
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a steel pressure reactor with a tick, and a sealed glass bottle used for a pressure reaction crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 带压反应，只用合格的高压釜。
overlay: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 【实拍】冷态高压釜的铭牌位置、压力表和安全阀（不加压，遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the blank nameplate, the pressure gauge and the safety valve on top of a cold, unpressurised steel reactor.
shots.narration: 看铭牌：额定压力和温度别超。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 压力表、安全阀在检定有效期内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure gauge and a safety valve each with a blank valid label and a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 压力表、安全阀定期检定，完好有效。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 装料不超量，密封面清洁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reactor vessel filled only partly with a level line, a clean sealing surface with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 装料不超量，密封面擦干净。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 螺栓对角均匀拧紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reactor lid with bolts numbered by position and arrows showing diagonal tightening order, numbers only as dots. No text.
shots.narration: 螺栓对角均匀拧紧，按规程试漏。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 高压釜放在防护屏后或专用房间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure reactor behind a protective barrier in a dedicated room, a person watching from outside. No text.
shots.narration: 放在防护屏后或专用区域运行。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 门口挂标识：运行中、压力、负责人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank sign hanging on the reactor area with a pressure icon and a person icon. No text.
shots.narration: 挂标识：在做什么、谁负责。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 运行中有人看守，超温超压立即停止加热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person watching the gauges of a running reactor, an alarm bell, and a hand switching off the heater. No text.
shots.narration: 有人值守，超温超压立即停热撤离。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 降温、压力归零、放空后再开盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three steps, a thermometer going down, a pressure gauge at zero and a vent valve opened, then the lid lifted. No text.
shots.narration: 降温泄压归零，再开盖。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 带压拆螺栓打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand loosening reactor bolts while the gauge still shows pressure, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 带压拆螺栓，绝对禁止。

shots.section_title: 压力反应用合格高压釜，泄压后再开
shots.scene: 属于特种设备的登记检验
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large reactor matched to a special equipment catalogue with a registration certificate. No text.
shots.narration: 属于压力容器的，依法登记检验。

shots.section_title: 产气的反应和培养防憋压
shots.scene: 厌氧培养罐和发酵瓶不断产气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an anaerobic culture jar and a fermentation bottle with gas bubbles rising and pressure arrows inside. No text.
shots.narration: 厌氧培养、发酵和某些反应会产气。
overlay: 产气的反应和培养防憋压

shots.section_title: 产气的反应和培养防憋压
shots.scene: 密闭太死，盖子崩开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tightly sealed culture vessel whose lid blows off from built up gas, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 封得太死会憋压，崩开伤人。

shots.section_title: 产气的反应和培养防憋压
shots.scene: 气体可能有毒或易燃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas cloud from a culture vessel with toxic and flammable warning signs. No text.
shots.narration: 产的气可能有毒，也可能易燃。

shots.section_title: 产气的反应和培养防憋压
shots.scene: 用带排气口的容器，按规程排气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a culture vessel with a vent filter cap and a gas release valve, gas going into a fume hood. No text.
shots.narration: 用带排气的容器，按规程排气。

shots.section_title: 产气的反应和培养防憋压
shots.scene: 在通风柜里慢慢开启，开口不对人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person slowly opening a gas producing vessel inside a fume hood with the opening pointed away from the face. No text.
shots.narration: 在通风处慢慢开启，开口不对人。

shots.section_title: 产气的反应和培养防憋压
shots.scene: 装置漏气、破裂：停止、撤离、报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked vessel releasing gas, a person stepping back and calling the lab supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 破裂漏气：停止、撤离、报告负责人。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 查裂纹、圆底瓶、防护屏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a magnifier over a flask, a round bottom flask and a safety shield. No text.
shots.narration: 真空：查裂纹，用耐压器皿，加防护。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 安全瓶、先放气、冷阱、尾气入柜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a safety trap bottle, an open vent valve, a cold trap and a fume hood. No text.
shots.narration: 安全瓶、先放气、冷阱、尾气入柜。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 不密闭加热、高压釜、泄压归零
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a crossed out closed flask on a hot plate, a pressure reactor and a gauge at zero. No text.
shots.narration: 不密闭加热，压力归零再开盖。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在带护罩的机器旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a machine with a closed transparent guard over its moving parts and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：机械防护。
